title: Why willpower isn't enough for habit change

scenes.say: You'd expect them to win more fights with temptation. Research suggests they just have fewer fights.
One explanation is habits. The mithai box sits on a high shelf, bedtime stays fixed, and the choice runs on autopilot.
In one study, 205 adults were beeped seven times a day for a week. Desires clashed with goals often. Those high in self-control reported fewer clashes and resisted less.

bars.label: Of those, clashed with a goal

scenes.say: Six later studies found habits like exercise, sleep and studying help explain why self-control pays off.
Tonight, move one temptation out of sight. Send this to the friend with a snack drawer.
